 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is the second application seeking for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of accused-appellant No.1 namely Mukesh Sour who has been convicted under Section 363 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 05 years and fine of Rs.10,000/-, under Section 366 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I.
for 07 years and fine of Rs.10,000/- and under Section 376-D of the IPC and sentenced to undergo life imprisonment and fine of Rs.50,000/- with default stipulations vide impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 22.11.2018 passed by the Special Judge (POCSO) Jatara, District Tikamgarh (M.P.) in Special Case No.113 of 2013.
3.
This application has been filed on the ground that there is delay in lodging the FIR of 10 days.
The present appellant has been falsely implicated in the case.

The prosecutrix (PW-1) was having an affair with the co-accused Kishan Sour and when he was caught red handed by the police, a false story has been created and the present appellant has been implicated in the case.
There is no specific allegation made against the present appellant.
The bail application of the other co-accused Babulal Sour has been allowed.
There is no role assigned to the present appellant in fleeing the prosecutrix and co-accused Kishan Sour.
Present appellant is in custody since 07.03.2013.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering his application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

4. Per contra, learned counsel appearing for the State has vehemently opposed the contentions stating therein that the principal accused Kishan Sour is still absconding and the application of the other co-accused Babulal Sour has been allowed on the ground that there were no allegation of Mukesh Sour vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196556485/
1 committing rape against him.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is a specific allegation of committing rape against the present appellant and Kamal Kishore.
Under these circumstances, he has prayed for dismissal of the application.

5. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that there is a specific allegation of committing rape against the present appellant coupled with the fact that the other co-accused Kishan Sour is still absconding in the matter, under these circumstances, this Court does not deem it appropriate to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant and release him on bail.
6. I.A. No.9509 of 2023 is accordingly dismissed.

(RAVI MALIMATH) (
 CHIEF JUSTICE   SSL Mukesh Sour vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196556485/
